newsitem.title: USA: Incontrol says FDA OKs broader Metrix trial.
newsitem.headline: Incontrol says FDA OKs broader Metrix trial.

text.p: InControl Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the expansion of clinical trials for its defibrillation implant device, Metrix.
The company said the expanded trial authority follows the conclusion of an initial safety study conducted at five U.S. hospitals.
Under the clinical trial, the device will be available for implant at 25 hospitals nationwide, it said.

"In addition to evaluating the system's safety and efficacy, physicians for the first time will be able to deliver therapy both inside and outside the hospital or clinic," InControl executive vice president Jerry Griffin said in a written statement.
The device has already been cleared for commercialization in come European countries, the company said.
